subject: Human Body
title: How Nails Grow
description: A quick win: understand How Nails Grow.

hook.text: Your fingernails grow about 3.5 mm per month. Toenails grow half as fast. The nail you see is already dead keratin.

buildup.text: Nails grow from the matrix, hidden under the cuticle.

discovery.text: The white half-moon (lunula) at the nail base is the visible part of the matrix.

twist.text: Nails grow faster on your dominant hand and in summer.

punchline.text: Nails are dead skin, hardened and stacked. Same protein, different form.

quiz.question: Why do fingernails grow faster on the dominant hand?
options: The dominant hand has more nail matrix cells
More frequent use increases blood flow, speeding cell division
Nerve stimulation from typing and gripping triggers faster growth
